geometry._help: Angles in degrees, one value per leg (leg i is driven by motors[i]). alpha1: ring axis(-z) -> middle joint axis. alpha2: middle joint axis -> head joint axis. beta: effector axis -> head joint axis. eta: azimuth of each head joint around the effector axis. branch: +1/-1 elbow direction of each leg (flip if the 3D view doesn't match the CAD at home).
geometry._source: Measured from 'bone-in SPM.step' (Onshape, 2026-11-17) with experiments/cad_axes.py: all 7 joint axes meet at the head centre (0.000 mm); leg i = arm i on the ring driven by pinion i. Effector z = femur-head symmetry axis (= femoral neck / screw-hole axis).

mount._help: How the SPM base sits on the pelvis. The ring axis (base -> head) points laterally, tipped down by tilt_down_deg and swung forward by forward_deg. base_twist_deg spins the base about its own axis.
mount._source: From the CAD pose taken as anatomical neutral (RIGHT femur): pelvis Y = knee centre -> head centre, Z = knee medial-lateral axis (widest direction of the distal 40 mm), X = Y x Z. Ring axis points lateral, 24.6 deg down and 20.1 deg POSTERIOR. Knee ML axis uncertain by ~5 deg.

neutral._help: Effector orientation (in the base frame) at anatomical neutral, as rotations from the mechanism's symmetric home: R = Rz(twist) Ry(tilt_y) Rx(tilt_x). From the CAD this design stands 17.9 deg away from the symmetric home at neutral.

limits._help: Safety gate. Poses failing any check are refused and the last safe pose is held. min_ring_separation_deg and joint_limits are link collisions measured from the CAD (experiments/cad_collision.py): arms touch at 43.5 deg ring separation (+1.5 deg margin); elbow/wrist = passive-joint fold intervals from neutral. All other part pairs keep >= 4.8 mm inside these limits. max_tilt_deg is only a backstop (not binding with the CAD limits).

joint_limits._source: experiments/cad_collision.py on bone-in SPM.step: contact (< 0.3 mm) angles relative to the CAD assembly pose; +-180 = never collides
joint_limits._ref_help: ref_R_BE = effector orientation of the CAD assembly pose (base frame). Reference for the elbow/wrist angles and for experiments/cad_collision.py. It stays fixed when the base is remounted (neutral changes); re-run cad_collision.py only if the CAD itself changes.

imu._help: Femur IMU board over USB. trim_gain (1/s) > 0 closes an outer loop on the IMU-measured TILT error (0 = monitor only). trim_limit_deg caps the correction.
